title: Prediction switches under the learned leaf
source: Source: reports/prediction-tables.mdx and the per-lineup synthesis in reports/tables-retest.mdx; analysis/prediction_tables.py. Builders are after-the-fact pools of boards 0–63 and 800–863, population uses 800–863. Each pair is 512 completed games; all 18 finalized halves completed 256 games. An interrupted attempt and six withdrawn full-blend registrations are excluded from the completed denominator and preserved in the report. Denial runs on the quarter blend, other arms on tables alone. Reported 95% intervals.
caption: Every pooled prediction interval crosses zero at both tables.
